hypothesis: Most states cost approximately 63,000 instructions; the two earliest short-sequence states are substantially higher. First decode of short prompts may proxy runtime specialization overhead. Conditional prompt length allows the elevated states to differ without imposing a length trend on steady-state calls.

pcvs.name: sequence_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Retains sequence-length variation across the observed workload.

pcvs.name: short_prompt_first_decode
pcvs.rationale: Tests whether the elevated costs belong to the first decode of short prompts, which occur during initial runtime specialization.

pcvs.expression: request.num_prompt_tokens if request.num_prompt_tokens < 16 and request.num_output_tokens == 1 else 0
pcvs.name: short_prompt_first_decode_length
pcvs.rationale: Allows length-dependent cost within the hypothesized initial decode regime.
